text: Biology is a fundamental discipline of natural science that studies life phenomena and their laws, covering multi-level life systems from molecules, cells, tissues, organs to individuals, populations, communities and ecosystems. As a discipline that emphasizes both experimental and theoretical aspects, it not only explores the essence of life (such as genetic mechanisms and evolutionary laws), but also addresses practical issues such as human health, agricultural production, and ecological protection. Modern biology has been integrated with medicine, information technology, engineering and other fields, giving rise to emerging areas such as biomedical engineering, synthetic biology and bioinformatics. It is one of the core disciplines of natural science in the 21st century.
